items.title: 3 reasons software stocks are making a comeback
items.summary: Software stocks (IGV) have moved into the green after several difficult months driven by AI disruption fears. Citizens head of technology equity research, Pat Walravens, sits down with Market Domination host Josh Lipton to explain why software is rebounding and what to expect going forward.

items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Backs Workforce AI And Adds New AgentExchange Email Tool
items.summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) led an investment in HR platform HiBob to support enterprise AI tied to workforce data. HiBob plans to use the funding to build trusted organizational context that can feed Salesforce powered AI systems. Sinch introduced a Mailgun Inspect integration on Salesforce AgentExchange that plugs email reputation data into customer workflows.
